```{r}
#| label: setup
library(highcharter)

chart_lang <- getOption("highcharter.lang")
chart_lang$decimalPoint <- ","
chart_lang$thousandsSep <- "."
chart_lang$rangeSelectorZoom <- ""
chart_lang$shortMonths <- c(
  "ene", "feb", "mar", "abr", "may", "jun",
  "jul", "ago", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dic"
)
options(highcharter.lang = chart_lang)

find_project_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, "config", "series.yml"))) return(path)
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) stop("Could not locate the project root.")
    path <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
series_dir <- file.path(project_root, "api", "v1", "series")
indicators_payload <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(project_root, "api", "v1", "indicators.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)
manifest_payload <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(project_root, "api", "v1", "manifest.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)
indicators <- indicators_payload$indicators
catalog_series_count <- as.integer(manifest_payload$catalog_series_count)
catalog_size_label <- if (catalog_series_count >= 1000L) {
  paste0("más de ", floor(catalog_series_count / 1000), " mil series")
} else {
  paste(catalog_series_count, "series")
}

read_series <- function(id) {
  payload <- jsonlite::read_json(
    file.path(series_dir, paste0(id, ".json")),
    simplifyVector = TRUE
  )
  data.frame(
    date = as.Date(payload$observations$date),
    value = as.numeric(payload$observations$value)
  )
}

format_percent <- function(x) scales::percent(x / 100, accuracy = 0.1, decimal.mark = ",")
format_number <- function(x) scales::number(x, accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
format_currency <- function(x) scales::dollar(x, accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")

make_chart <- function(
  id,
  indicator_name,
  description,
  formatter = format_number,
  value_suffix = "",
  value_decimals = 2,
  zero_line = FALSE
) {
  data <- read_series(id)
  data <- data[is.finite(data$value), , drop = FALSE]
  last_date <- max(data$date)
  first_date <- seq(last_date, by = "-5 years", length.out = 2L)[[2L]]
  visible <- data[data$date >= first_date, , drop = FALSE]
  latest <- tail(visible$value, 1L)
  plot_lines <- if (zero_line) {
    list(list(value = 0, color = "#c6a15b", width = 1, zIndex = 2))
  } else {
    list()
  }
  title_html <- paste0(
    '<span class="chart-indicator-heading">',
    '<span class="chart-indicator-name">',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(indicator_name),
    '</span>',
    '<span class="chart-indicator-value">',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(formatter(latest)),
    '</span>',
    '</span>'
  )

  highcharter::hchart(
    visible,
    "line",
    highcharter::hcaes(x = date, y = value),
    name = indicator_name
  ) |>
    highcharter::hc_chart(
      backgroundColor = "transparent",
      zoomType = "x",
      spacing = c(8, 8, 4, 8)
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_title(
      text = title_html,
      useHTML = TRUE,
      align = "center",
      verticalAlign = "top",
      y = 14
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_subtitle(
      text = paste0(
        description,
        ". Último dato: ",
        format(last_date, "%d-%m-%Y")
      ),
      align = "center",
      y = 92,
      style = list(color = "#53636d", fontSize = "11px")
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_xAxis(
      type = "datetime",
      ordinal = FALSE,
      title = list(text = NULL),
      lineWidth = 0,
      tickWidth = 0,
      gridLineWidth = 1,
      gridLineColor = "#e7ebee",
      labels = list(style = list(color = "#53636d", fontSize = "11px"))
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_yAxis(
      title = list(text = ""),
      opposite = TRUE,
      gridLineWidth = 1,
      gridLineColor = "#e7ebee",
      plotLines = plot_lines,
      labels = list(style = list(color = "#53636d", fontSize = "11px"))
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_plotOptions(
      series = list(
        animation = FALSE,
        connectNulls = TRUE,
        lineWidth = 2.5,
        marker = list(
          enabled = FALSE,
          states = list(
            hover = list(
              enabled = TRUE,
              radius = 5,
              lineColor = "#ffffff",
              lineWidth = 2
            )
          )
        ),
        states = list(hover = list(lineWidthPlus = 0))
      )
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_tooltip(
      enabled = FALSE,
      shared = TRUE,
      valueDecimals = value_decimals,
      valueSuffix = value_suffix,
      xDateFormat = "%d %b %Y"
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_rangeSelector(
      enabled = TRUE,
      selected = 1,
      inputEnabled = FALSE,
      buttonTheme = list(
        fill = "transparent",
        stroke = "#d8dee7",
        style = list(color = "#53636d", fontSize = "10px"),
        states = list(select = list(fill = "#eaf6fa", style = list(color = "#003b5c")))
      ),
      buttons = list(
        list(type = "ytd", text = "YTD"),
        list(type = "year", count = 1, text = "1a"),
        list(type = "year", count = 5, text = "5a")
      )
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_navigator(
      enabled = TRUE,
      height = 24,
      maskFill = "rgba(0, 59, 92, 0.08)",
      series = list(color = "#75bddb", lineWidth = 1)
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_scrollbar(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_legend(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_exporting(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_credits(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_colors("#003b5c")
}
```

    '</span>'
  )
}, character(1))

  '  if (ticker) ticker.classList.toggle("is-paused");',
  '});',
  '</script>'
)

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const syncDelay = 300;
  const boundCharts = new WeakSet();
  let syncTimer = null;
  let touchPinned = false;
  let activeTooltip = null;
  let highlightedPoints = [];

  function dashboardCharts() {
    if (!window.Highcharts) return [];
    return Highcharts.charts.filter(function (chart) {
      return chart && chart.container && chart.xAxis && chart.xAxis.length;
    });
  }

  function primarySeries(chart) {
    return chart.series.find(function (series) {
      return series.visible && !series.options.isInternal;
    });
  }

  function latestPointAtOrBefore(series, timestamp) {
    const points = series.points || [];
    let low = 0;
    let high = points.length - 1;
    let match = null;

    while (low <= high) {
      const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
      const point = points[middle];
      if (point.x <= timestamp) {
        match = point;
        low = middle + 1;
      } else {
        high = middle - 1;
      }
    }

    return match;
  }

  function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (character) {
      return {
        "&": "&amp;",
        "<": "&lt;",
        ">": "&gt;",
        "\"": "&quot;",
        "'": "&#039;"
      }[character];
    });
  }

  function formatValue(chart, point) {
    const options = chart.options.tooltip || {};
    const decimals = Number.isInteger(options.valueDecimals)
      ? options.valueDecimals
      : 2;
    const value = new Intl.NumberFormat("es-CL", {
      minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
      maximumFractionDigits: decimals
    }).format(point.y);
    return value + (options.valueSuffix || "");
  }

  function formatDate(timestamp) {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("es-CL", {
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
      timeZone: "UTC"
    }).format(new Date(timestamp));
  }

  function comparisonRows(timestamp) {
    return dashboardCharts().map(function (chart) {
      const series = primarySeries(chart);
      const point = series && latestPointAtOrBefore(series, timestamp);
      return point ? { chart: chart, series: series, point: point } : null;
    }).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function clearComparison() {
    window.clearTimeout(syncTimer);
    highlightedPoints.forEach(function (point) {
      point.setState("");
    });
    highlightedPoints = [];
    if (activeTooltip) activeTooltip.remove();
    activeTooltip = null;
  }

  function renderComparison(activeChart, activePoint) {
    const rows = comparisonRows(activePoint.x);
    const active = rows.find(function (row) {
      return row.chart === activeChart;
    });
    if (!active) return;

    clearComparison();
    highlightedPoints = rows.map(function (row) {
      row.point.setState("hover");
      return row.point;
    });

    const otherRows = rows.filter(function (row) {
      return row !== active;
    }).map(function (row) {
      return [
        '<div class="comparison-tooltip__row">',
        '<span class="comparison-tooltip__name">', escapeHtml(row.series.name), '</span>',
        '<strong>', escapeHtml(formatValue(row.chart, row.point)), '</strong>',
        '<time>', escapeHtml(formatDate(row.point.x)), '</time>',
        '</div>'
      ].join("");
    }).join("");

    const tooltip = document.createElement("div");
    tooltip.className = "comparison-tooltip";
    tooltip.setAttribute("role", "status");
    tooltip.innerHTML = [
      '<div class="comparison-tooltip__lead">',
      '<span>', escapeHtml(active.series.name), '</span>',
      '<strong>', escapeHtml(formatValue(active.chart, active.point)), '</strong>',
      '<time>', escapeHtml(formatDate(active.point.x)), '</time>',
      '</div>',
      '<div class="comparison-tooltip__rows">', otherRows, '</div>'
    ].join("");
    document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
    activeTooltip = tooltip;

    const gap = 14;
    const viewportGap = 8;
    const chartBounds = activeChart.container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pointX = activeChart.plotLeft + activePoint.plotX;
    const pointY = activeChart.plotTop + activePoint.plotY;
    const tooltipWidth = tooltip.offsetWidth;
    const tooltipHeight = tooltip.offsetHeight;
    const roomOnRight = window.innerWidth - chartBounds.right;
    const roomOnLeft = chartBounds.left;
    const pointViewportX = chartBounds.left + pointX;
    const pointViewportY = chartBounds.top + pointY;
    let preferredLeft;

    if (roomOnRight >= tooltipWidth + gap + viewportGap) {
      preferredLeft = chartBounds.right + gap;
    } else if (roomOnLeft >= tooltipWidth + gap + viewportGap) {
      preferredLeft = chartBounds.left - tooltipWidth - gap;
    } else {
      preferredLeft = pointViewportX > window.innerWidth / 2
        ? pointViewportX - tooltipWidth - gap
        : pointViewportX + gap;
    }

    tooltip.style.left = Math.max(
      viewportGap,
      Math.min(preferredLeft, window.innerWidth - tooltipWidth - viewportGap)
    ) + "px";
    tooltip.style.top = Math.max(
      viewportGap,
      Math.min(
        pointViewportY - tooltipHeight / 2,
        window.innerHeight - tooltipHeight - viewportGap
      )
    ) + "px";
  }

  function pointFromEvent(chart, event) {
    const normalized = chart.pointer.normalize(event);
    const insidePlot = chart.isInsidePlot(
      normalized.chartX - chart.plotLeft,
      normalized.chartY - chart.plotTop
    );
    const series = primarySeries(chart);
    return insidePlot && series ? series.searchPoint(normalized, true) : null;
  }

  function scheduleSynchronization(chart, point) {
    window.clearTimeout(syncTimer);
    syncTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
      renderComparison(chart, point);
    }, syncDelay);
  }

  function bindChart(chart) {
    if (boundCharts.has(chart)) return;
    boundCharts.add(chart);

    chart.container.addEventListener("pointermove", function (event) {
      if (touchPinned || event.pointerType === "touch") return;
      const point = pointFromEvent(chart, event);
      if (point) scheduleSynchronization(chart, point);
    });

    chart.container.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () {
      if (touchPinned) return;
      clearComparison();
    });

    chart.container.addEventListener("pointerup", function (event) {
      if (event.pointerType !== "touch") return;
      if (touchPinned) {
        touchPinned = false;
        clearComparison();
        return;
      }
      const point = pointFromEvent(chart, event);
      if (!point) return;
      touchPinned = true;
      renderComparison(chart, point);
    });
  }

  function installSynchronizedTooltips(attempt) {
    const charts = dashboardCharts();
    charts.forEach(bindChart);
    if (attempt < 20) {
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        installSynchronizedTooltips(attempt + 1);
      }, 100);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    installSynchronizedTooltips(0);
  });
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
    touchPinned = false;
    clearComparison();
  });
  window.addEventListener("scroll", function () {
    touchPinned = false;
    clearComparison();
  }, true);
})();
</script>
```
